'''Mama the Hutt's house''' was a building located on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was the home of [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro the Hutt's]] [[Mama/Legends|mother]]. Although Mama's children were successful, her hut was built mainly for modesty. [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos's]] expression of the house was not favorable when he reported that it smelled like someone [[Death/Legends|died]].
